en: It is obvious that Rosa is tired.
es: Es obvio que Rosa está cansada.
why: A plain fact takes the normal verb.

en: It is necessary that you come early.
why: Necessary is a judgment, so the subjunctive.

en: It is true that the café opens at six.
es: Es verdad que el café abre a las seis.

en: It is clear that Vale knows.
It is strange that Vale is not here.
es: Es raro que Vale no esté aquí.
why: Strange is a reaction, so the subjunctive.

en: It is good that you speak Spanish.
why: Good is a judgment, so the subjunctive.

en: It is evident that the park is closed.
es: Es evidente que el parque está cerrado.

en: It is incredible that she cooks so well.
es: Es increíble que cocine tan bien.
why: Incredible is a reaction, so the subjunctive.

en: It is true that we have time.
It is normal that he is nervous.
why: Normal is a judgment, so the subjunctive.

en: It is a pity that it's raining today.
es: Es una lástima que llueva hoy.
why: A pity is a reaction, so the subjunctive.

en: It is obvious that it rains a lot here.
es: Es obvio que llueve mucho aquí.

en: It is important that we pay today.
why: Important is a judgment, so the subjunctive.
